remarks_1999: Whitney Archive in 1969 indicates, "Seen in N.Y. warehouse, OK coll. 3/30/70. Notes made." Titled *Tan–Orange, Yellow, Lavender* by O'Keeffe on Abiquiú Notebooks photograph. Backing inscription dates 1959, 1960. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

description: Canvas on mostly fiery orange, reddish and pink.  Arial view of riverbed winding through the landscape, but abstracted to the point that the sinuous lines could be that of a tree.
